reconstructed_values.bucket_shell_note: Width is a compatible published HD 1.19 m3 table option, but pin-on/coupler identity remains unresolved; shell curvature and volume are not engineering-validated.
reconstructed_values.wheel_and_roller_centers: Reconstructed from the published track length, roller-center length, counts, and visible first-party illustrations.
reconstructed_values.cab_house_counterweight_panels: Independently authored from first-party illustration observations; no hidden internal assembly is represented.
reconstructed_values.hose_bundle_paths: Reconstructed exterior routing cues only; no hose diameter, pressure, fitting, or service authority.
reconstructed_values.hydraulic_anchors: All base and rod anchor coordinates are reconstructed. Published strokes constrain future solver work only.
reconstructed_values.bucket_linkage: Bellcrank, dogbone, bucket lug, and all pin locations are reconstructed visual closure cues only.
reconstructed_values.inspection_volumes: Envelope and component volumes are non-authoritative visualization aids.
